Participant Travel on Awards

From the ORA eTraining module "Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs" (lesson 6 of 9).
Participant Travel on Awards
Notes
Participant travel refers to travel costs provided for individuals under a sponsored project as trainees, attendees, or other supported participants, rather than as employees working on the award. In Banner, these costs are charged to the 04 (Travel) pool level, even though the travel is for participant support purposes. For awards with significant participant support costs, including travel, it may be helpful to establish a separate index to keep those expenses clearly separated from other project charges. The RFA team can assist with creating that index when needed. If a separate index is not created, it is important to work closely with your project's RFA accountant to ensure participant travel expenses are not inadvertently included in indirect cost calculations. From a processing standpoint, participant travel documents move through the same travel request (TL Form) and reimbursement process used for other travel-related expenses on Morgan awards. A clear process map for travel requests is included in the Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement e-module.
